definitionMetadata.table_description:
This is a fact table with one row per OpenConnect Appliance (OCA) Session

The table has a unique row for each
  • Playback Lifecycle ID (playback_lifecycle_id)
  • Playback Correlation ID (playback_correlation_id)
  • OCA ID (cdn_id)

The table is continuously updated by a [flink job](https://rtdiportal.prod.netflix.net/streaming-jobs/ocf/oca_session/config?env=prod®ion=us-east-1). Records are grouped in the flink job using a dynamic window and will not show up in this table for up to 3 hours.

VTTS is advanced by the [sde.oca_session_f.ready workflow](https://data.netflix.net/maestro/prod/sde.oca_session_f.ready).

fields.comment:
List of stats for each TCP connection in this oca session
*Introduced: 20230901*
See: [Netflix T-Digest Documentation](https://manuals.netflix.net/view/sde.nflx_tdigest/mkdocs/master/tdigest/)

  • connection_id - Unique identifier for this connection. Currently sourced from cdn_selections.other_properties.rowId

  • template_schema_hash - Version identifier for the TCP stats json blob

  • payload_bytes - Payload bytes

  • retransmit_bytes - Retransmit bytes

  • mss_bytes - Maximum segment size in bytes

  • stack_bytes_served - List of stack names and their associated bytes served

  • rtt_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • gput_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • path_rtt_tdigest - Netflix T-Digest

  • unique_connection_count - Should always be 1 in this table

  • total_connection_count - Should always be 1 in this table
